result.summary: Patched 10 source migrations (004, 007, 008, 010, 012, 019, 026, 058, 093, 095) with ISS-0641/GH-637 documentation comments recording each table's classification. Added migrations/GBL-141_iss0641_drop_dual_schema_shadows.sql (drops 13 PER_TENANT public shadows + 1 GLOBAL_REGISTRY tenant-schema shadow, idempotent, RESTRICT-only, per-table dependent_objects_still_exist guards, loops public.tenant for multi-tenant coverage). Applied via `BPM_DB_URL=$BPM_TEST_DB_URL zig build migrate` and against bpm_dev. Two self-caught defects during implementation, both fixed before finalizing: (1) an initial attempt added a file-level `-- scope: public` header to 058_repo_artifacts_tenant_activation.sql copying the ISS-0101/GBL-140 pattern directly, which would have wrongly suppressed the HYBRID repository_artifacts table's tenant_default copy in the same file -- caught by running the full cold-start test-integration suite and observing TC-ISS-0185-03/TC-EXP-103-03 regressions, reverted to documentation-only for that file; (2) a comment draft contained the literal substring '-- scope: public' inside backtick-quoted prose explaining what not to do, which migrationScope()'s naive substring search matched, triggering a MigrationScopeMismatch build error on cold-start migrate -- reworded to remove the literal trigger string. zig build exits 0 with no error-set output. lint_sql_param_types.py: 0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR. lint_dual_schema_table_names.py: 14 -> 0 on both bpm_test and bpm_dev. zig build migrate idempotent (two consecutive runs report 'No new migrations to apply').

issues.description: Two self-caught implementation mistakes (wrong scope header on 058; literal trigger-string match in a comment) were corrected before merge -- see result summary.
